00074 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
00075 // Macro:         BT_TRACE
00076 // Description:   writes message to stdio
00077 // Parameters:    _str_ input parameter compatible
00078 //              with printf
00079 
00080 #ifdef __KERNEL__
00081 #define BT_TRACE(_str_) \
00082                     HxInsainPrint ( " %d: ", current->pid ); \
00083                     HxInsainPrint( "%s", HxBtGetTab() ); \
00084                     HxInsainPrint _str_
00085 #else
00086 #define BT_TRACE(_str_) \
00087                     HxInsainPrint( "%s", HxBtGetTab() ); \
00088                     HxInsainPrint _str_
00089 #endif
00090 
00091 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
00092 // Macro:         BT_DBG_TRACE
00093 // Descrption:    prints the string to stdio
00094 //                as long as the debug level is
00095 //                appropriate
00096 #define BT_DBG_TRACE(_dbg_lvl_, _str_) \
00097         if( _dbg_lvl_ <= gBtDbgLvl )  { BT_TRACE (_str_); }
00098 
00099 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
00100 // Macro:           BT_DBG_STATUS

00102 //                  These are state changes or general

00104 #define BT_DBG_STATUS(_str_) BT_DBG_TRACE( BT_TRACE_STATUS, _str_)

00141 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
00142 // Macro:           BTFUNC_ENTER
00143 // Description:     Declares a var on the stack used
00144 //                  by BTFUNCT_START and BTFUNC_EXIT.
00145 
00146 #define BTFUNC_ENTER(_str_)  const char functName[] = "[BluCore] " _str_
00147 
00148 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
00149 // Macro:           BTFUNC_ENTER
00150 // Description:     Dumps function name to debugger if the
00151 //                  appropriate debug level is set.
00152 // Precond:         BTFUNCT_ENTER must be the first line
00153 //                  in a function.
00154 #define BTFUNC_START() \
00155                   { BT_DBG_TRACE(BT_TRACE_VERBOSE, (functName));  \
00156                     BT_DBG_TRACE(BT_TRACE_VERBOSE, (" {\n"));      \
00157                     if(BT_TRACE_VERBOSE == gBtDbgLvl )             \
00158                     {HxBtDbgIncTab();} }
00159 
00160 //~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
00161 // Macro:           BTFUNC_EXIT
00162 // Description:     macro that dumps message to debugger
00163 //                  depending on debug level that function
00164 //                  is exiting and what the exit value is.
00165 // Precond:         BTFUNCT_ENTER must be the first line
00166 //                  in a function.
00167 #define BTFUNC_EXIT(_ret_val_)  \
00168                   if(BT_TRACE_VERBOSE == gBtDbgLvl )          \
00169                   { HxBtDbgDecTab(); }                          \
00170                   BT_DBG_TRACE(BT_TRACE_VERBOSE, (functName));   \
00171                   BT_DBG_TRACE(BT_TRACE_VERBOSE, (" } 0x%x\n", _ret_val_))
00172
